title.zh: 轴对称中性分布矩归约

summary: Recover the density, axial flux and flow speed, pressure, temperature, diagonal stresses and random heat flux of an H or H2 one-dimensional-space, two-dimensional-axisymmetric velocity distribution, with the declared constants, cylindrical sigma_zz = sigma_yy identification, and empty-slice policies.

capability: Recover the density, axial flux and flow speed, pressure, temperature, diagonal stresses and random heat flux of an H or H2 one-dimensional-space, two-dimensional-axisymmetric velocity distribution, with the declared constants, cylindrical sigma_zz = sigma_yy identification, and empty-slice policies.
operation: reduce an axisymmetric velocity distribution to its moments
distribution plus axes, volume, normalization and species scalars -> nine moment profiles
discovery.model: Discrete cylindrical velocity-space moment reduction of one distribution under thermal-speed normalization
discovery.geometry: one-dimensional space, two-dimensional axisymmetric velocity space
discovery.boundary: finite 3-D distribution aligned to the axes; finite positive volume; positive normalization temperature and mass; molecularity in {1, 2}; empty_slice_policy in {reject, source_default}

identity.relation: the cylindrical velocity-space moment integrals of one distribution with thermal-speed normalization Vth = sqrt(2 e T_norm / (m_amu m_H))
identity.direction: distribution plus axes, volume, normalization and species scalars -> nine moment profiles
identity.definition: density = integral of f over velocity; axial_flux = Vth * integral(vx f); flow = flux/density; pressure and stresses from the centered second moments about the flow in eV m^-3; heat flux from the centered third moment in W m^-2; sigma_zz is returned as an independent copy of sigma_yy (the declared cylindrical identification); the optional explicit quadrature pair must reconstruct cylindrical_volume exactly and switches to the declared per-slice summation order
identity.model: Discrete cylindrical velocity-space moment reduction of one distribution under thermal-speed normalization
identity.geometry: one-dimensional space, two-dimensional axisymmetric velocity space
identity.coordinates: velocity axes and distributions in the source's normalized units; density m^-3, flux m^2 s^-1, flow m/s, pressure and stresses eV m^-3, temperature eV, heat flux W m^-2
identity.boundary: finite 3-D distribution aligned to the axes; finite positive volume; positive normalization temperature and mass; molecularity in {1, 2}; empty_slice_policy in {reject, source_default}
assumptions: sigma_zz = sigma_yy is the declared cylindrical symmetry identification; whether the contract should return an independent zz stress is an open expert question.
The source_default empty-slice policy (flow 0 m/s, temperature 1 eV on zero-density slices) reports the neutral initial values for callers that need them; reject is the default.
The moment recovery assumes the caller's distribution already carries the declared normalization; this asset reduces, it does not renormalize.

The fail-closed finiteness checks extend the declared contract: non-finite velocity axes, volume weights, normalization temperature or mass, and any non-finite returned field, are rejected; the earlier behavior did not gate them, and its divergences are pinned by regression tests.

Declared tightenings: complex distribution input fails closed (the earlier behavior silently discarded the imaginary part), and a 0-D scalar vx now fails closed with ValueError because the axes must be one-dimensional arrays; a zero node inside a one-dimensional mesh stays valid.

The isotope_mass_amu parameter multiplies the declared hydrogen mass 1.6726231e-27 kg, not a standard atomic mass unit. This asset additionally rejects boolean, numeric-string and complex array coercions, nonnumeric scalar inputs and noninteger molecularity; the finite real-valued arithmetic and summation order are unchanged.

inputs.name: distribution
inputs.constraints: A finite three-dimensional array aligned to the axes.

inputs.name: cylindrical_volume
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive, aligned to the axes.

inputs.name: isotope_mass_amu
inputs.description: The mass factor relative to the declared hydrogen mass, despite the parameter name.
inputs.units: multiples of saved hydrogen mass (1.6726231e-27 kg)

inputs.name: molecularity
inputs.description: The species branch: 1 for H, 2 for H2.

inputs.name: axial_quadrature
inputs.constraints: Positive, aligned; must be provided together with radial_quadrature; together they must reconstruct cylindrical_volume exactly.

inputs.name: radial_quadrature
inputs.constraints: Positive, aligned; must be provided together with axial_quadrature.

inputs.name: empty_slice_policy
inputs.constraints: Exactly 'reject' (fail closed) or 'source_default' (flow 0 m/s, temperature 1 eV).

outputs.name: moments
outputs.constraints: Exactly density_m3, axial_flux_m2_s, axial_velocity_m_s, pressure_ev_m3, temperature_ev, stress_xx_ev_m3, stress_yy_ev_m3, stress_zz_ev_m3 (an independent copy of the y stress), random_heat_flux_w_m2; each finite with shape [nx].

preconditions: Finite aligned distribution and quadrature with positive volume weights and species scalars.
supported: Moment diagnostics for H (molecularity 1) and H2 (molecularity 2) distributions on a shared cylindrical quadrature.
excluded: Distributions on other quadrature geometries; renormalization of caller distributions; nonpositive-volume meshes.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when the distribution/quadrature/species contract is violated, including non-real array coercions and nonnumeric or noninteger scalars, the explicit quadrature does not reconstruct cylindrical_volume, the policy enum is invalid, or (under 'reject') any spatial slice has nonpositive density.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the evaluation produces a non-finite result where the contract demands finiteness; no fallback is selected.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.

python.signature: reduce_axisymmetric_neutral_moments(distribution, vx, vr, cylindrical_volume, normalization_temperature_ev, isotope_mass_amu, molecularity, *, axial_quadrature=None, radial_quadrature=None, empty_slice_policy='reject')

example.description: Reduce one random distribution, confirm the sigma_zz alias and the empty-slice divergence, and witness flow and temperature recovery on a shifted-Maxwellian-like distribution.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import compute_thermal_speed_m_s, reduce_axisymmetric_neutral_moments
vr = (np.arange(160) + 0.5) * (4.0 / 160)
vx = -4.0 + (np.arange(200) + 0.5) * (10.0 / 200)
volume = np.outer(vr * (4.0 / 160), np.full(200, 10.0 / 200))
vth = compute_thermal_speed_m_s(2.0, 1.0)['thermal_speed_m_s']
vr_grid, vx_grid = np.meshgrid(vr, vx, indexing='ij')
shift = 3.0e3 / vth
f = np.exp(-(vr_grid[:, :, None] ** 2 + (vx_grid[:, :, None] - shift) ** 2))
f = np.broadcast_to(f, (160, 200, 1)).copy()
result = reduce_axisymmetric_neutral_moments(f, vx, vr, volume, normalization_temperature_ev=2.0, isotope_mass_amu=1.0, molecularity=1)
assert abs(result['axial_velocity_m_s'][0] - 3.0e3) < 0.02 * 3.0e3
assert abs(result['temperature_ev'][0] - 2.0) < 0.05 * 2.0
assert np.array_equal(result['stress_zz_ev_m3'], result['stress_yy_ev_m3'])
zero = np.zeros_like(f)
try:
    reduce_axisymmetric_neutral_moments(zero, vx, vr, volume, normalization_temperature_ev=2.0, isotope_mass_amu=1.0, molecularity=1)
except ValueError as error:
    assert 'positive density' in str(error)
else:
    raise AssertionError('a zero-density slice must be rejected under the default policy')
example.expected: Observed PASS: Nine finite moment profiles; the shifted-Maxwellian witness recovers flow and temperature within quadrature accuracy; sigma_zz aliases sigma_yy; a zero-density slice fails closed under the default policy.

scope: That all nine default-policy fields are finite with the declared shape and density equals the direct cylindrical volume integral.
That the explicit-quadrature density follows the declared per-slice summation order and fails closed on a volume mismatch.
That a shifted-Maxwellian-like distribution recovers its flow speed and temperature within quadrature accuracy (independent physical witness).
That sigma_zz aliases sigma_yy as an independent copy, and that the two empty-slice policies diverge exactly as declared.
That non-finite velocity axes and non-real coercions fail closed under the declared input contract.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to the declared relation: density = integral of f over velocity; axial_flux = Vth * integral(vx f); flow = flux/density; pressure and stresses from the centered second moments about the flow in eV m^-3; heat flux from the centered third moment in W m^-2; sigma_zz is returned as an…. Evidence: test_axisymmetric_neutral_moments.py (16 recorded test functions; bound-file coverage; independent analytic/high-precision oracle); the contract example ran. Excluded scope: Distributions on other quadrature geometries; renormalization of caller distributions; nonpositive-volume meshes; external physical validation.
known_limitations: An independent zz stress is not provided: the sigma_zz = sigma_yy identification is part of the declared contract. Whether that identification is the intended published contract remains an open expert question.
Under 'source_default', zero-density slices report the declared neutral values (flow 0 m/s, temperature 1 eV), which are not physical measurements.
The independent analytic comparison does not replace an external experimental reference.
